ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the raw product was ingested into the system

reportName.description: Base file name of the ingested EDRS acquisition passes status report

reportFolder.description: Source folder or path where the report file was collected

file_name.description: File name of the source report

notes.description: Additional free-text notes attached to the report

file_class.description: File class of the source report

file_type.description: File type of the source report

source_system.description: System that produced the source report

source_creator.description: Identifier of the entity that created the source report

source_creator_version.description: Version of the entity that created the source report

source_creation_date.description: Creation date of the source report as declared by the producer

session_id_data.description: Identifier of the EDRS acquisition/data session

user_id.description: Identifier of the user associated with the acquisition session

trans_mode.description: Transmission mode used for the session

leo_satellite_id.description: Identifier of the LEO (low Earth orbit) satellite whose data is relayed

geo_satellite_id.description: Identifier of the GEO (geostationary EDRS relay) satellite

priority.description: Priority assigned to the acquisition session

start_time.description: Start time of the acquisition session

stop_time.description: Stop time of the acquisition session

reception_profile_id.description: Identifier of the reception profile used for the session

emergency_flag.description: Flag indicating whether the session was handled as an emergency

dcsu_id.description: Identifier of the DCSU (data collection/storage unit) involved in the session

execution_status.description: Execution status of the acquisition session

link_session_completion_time.description: Completion time of the link session

link_session_fer.description: Frame Error Rate of the link session

number_of_delivered_cadu.description: Number of CADUs (Channel Access Data Units) delivered during the session

number_of_missing_cadu.description: Number of CADUs (Channel Access Data Units) missing during the session

production_service_type.description: Production service type providing the report

production_service_name.description: Production service name providing the report
